p: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah: Who was also called Jezaniah, Jer 42:1.
proud men: This declares that pride is the cause of rebellion and contempt of God's ministers.
Thou speakest falsely: When the hypocrisy of the wicked is discovered, they burst forth into open rage: for they can abide nothing but flattery, read Isa 30:10.

not sent thee to say: He shows what is the nature of the hypocrites: that is, to pretend that they would obey God and embrace his word, if they were assured that his messenger spoke the truth: though indeed they are most far from all obedience.
setteth thee on against us: Thus the wicked not only contemn and hurt the messengers of God, but slander and speak wickedly of all them that support or favour the godly.
nations: As from the Moabites, Ammonites and Edomites, Jer 40:11.
prophet: When these wicked lead away by force.
Tahpanhes: A city in Egypt near to Nilus.
hide them in the clay in: Which signified that Nebuchadnezzar would come even to the gates of Pharaoh, where his brick kilns for his buildings were.
such as are for death to: Everyone will be slain by the means that God has appointed, Jer 15:2.
shepherd putteth on his garment: Meaning most easily and suddenly will he carry the Egyptians away.
